import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

numerical_cols = ['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level',

corr = df[numerical_cols].corr()

sns.heatmap(corr, annot=True, fmt=".2f", cmap='coolwarm', square=True, linewidths=0.5,

plt.title('Correlation Matrix of Sleep Health Metrics', fontsize=16)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
